title: streaming-contract-regression-canary-harness-and-output-schema-fingerprint
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a resilient regression and canary harness that validates API compatibility across streaming, function/tool calling, and structured outputs. This ticket implements: (1) a compact golden-prompt corpus and a deterministic fingerprint for canonical responses, (2) a contract checker for function-call frames and structured JSON outputs that tolerates allowed non-determinism, and (3) CI canaries that run lightweight streaming/latency checks on pull requests and scheduled runs. Goal: catch regressions that would break SDKs or downstream customers before release.
testing_plan: 1) Golden prompt runner: run corpus in headless mode across new commits; compute byte-level and normalized semantic fingerprints; fail on drift beyond threshold. 2) Streaming packet comparator: assert chunk boundaries and final tokens for streaming endpoints; flag reordering or missing termination events. 3) Function-call contract checker: validate call.name, args schema, arg types, and idempotency markers; support backwards-compatible relaxations via a compatibility matrix. 4) Structured output schema assertions: JSON schema + extraFields policy (allow|warn|fail). 5) Canary CI jobs: fast (5–10 prompts) gate on PRs; nightly expanded run (200 prompts) with regression report emailed to platform-owner. 6) Flake detection and triage: track intermittent failures to separate infra flake vs model drift.
acceptance_criteria: Golden corpus with 120 prompts added to repo and documented
Fingerprint algorithm implemented and unit-tested; baseline fingerprints committed
Contract checker verifies function-call frames and structured outputs with <2% false positives on synthetic noise tests
PR job added that runs streaming canary in under 90s and blocks merges on deterministic failures
Nightly expanded regression produces HTML report and posts summary to #platform-regressions
On-call playbook updated with rollback steps and how to interpret fingerprint diffs

next_steps: 1) Finalize normalization rules for fingerprinting (numbers, timestamps, whitespace). 2) Land PR with baseline fingerprints and fast canary in CI. 3) Run nightly expanded suite and validate false positive rate. 4) Catalog first set of regressions and assign owners.
notes: This harness must be conservative about failures: block on clear contract violations (missing function call, malformed JSON, streaming termination omissions) but prefer warnings for semantic drift. We will iterate thresholds after initial data from nightly runs. Coordinate with SDK and DX to ensure error messages are actionable.
